answer: Sybil defence starts where capital stops working. Holding tokens buys no standing; only graded work on the dune accrues. Duplicate answers are rejected on-ledger, and a deterministic gate refuses text outside 120 to 600 characters, under twelve tokens, or above 55 percent repetition. Bulk filler fails automatically, removing the cheapest thread a farm has: one phrase sent a thousand times. An attacker's arithmetic: N identities cost N independent generations per epoch forever, plus N chances of a failed grade, and the summit is shared, not multiplied. Seal 135e4.
